SELECT DATE(created_at) AS day, COUNT(*) AS count FROM `user` WHERE role = 'TEACHER' AND DATE(created_at) BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ORDER BY day ASC
SELECT DATE(start_time) AS day, COUNT(*) AS count FROM course WHERE DATE(start_time) BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} GROUP BY DATE(start_time) ORDER BY day ASC
